summary: This topic describes how to record purchase transactions in the system. It covers capturing details such as the vendor, payment method, purchased items, and the ability to upload supporting documents like purchase bills.
steps: Navigate to Inventory > Transactions > Purchase Entry (Assumed based on context).
Enter details of the vendor ('From whom you have purchased').
Specify the payment method (e.g., 'in what cash').
Enter details of the purchased items and their quantities.
Upload the purchase bill or other relevant documents.
business_rules: A purchase entry captures comprehensive details of a procurement transaction, not just the purchase bill.
Documents related to the purchase can be uploaded and attached to the entry.
important_notes: This entry provides a detailed record of 'how much purchase has been done'.
